zh_example: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

en_example: Our neighbour watered the plants while we were away.
zh_example: 我们不在家时，邻居帮忙给植物浇了水。

en_example: He joined a local organisation that rescues injured birds.
zh_example: 他加入了一个救助受伤鸟类的当地组织。

en_example: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
zh_example: 我们每年夏天都会为邻居们组织一次野餐。

en_example: Our car is near the parking lot entrance.
zh_example: 我们的车就在停车场入口附近。

en_definition: Involving fewer hours than a full working or studying week.
en_example: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
zh_example: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。

en_example: I found a penny underneath the sofa this morning.
zh_example: 今天早上我在沙发底下发现了一枚便士硬币。

en_definition: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.
en_example: I saved twenty percent on my new winter coat.
zh_example: 我买新冬衣时省了百分之二十的钱。

en_example: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
zh_example: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。

en_example: I dropped the birthday card into the postbox outside.
zh_example: 我把生日贺卡投进了外面的邮筒。

en_definition: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
en_example: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
zh_example: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

en_example: One sneaker was hiding under the kitchen chair.
zh_example: 一只运动鞋藏在厨房的椅子下面。

en_definition: to buy prepared food and eat it somewhere else
en_example: Could I have a vegetable sandwich to take away?
zh_example: 请给我一个蔬菜三明治打包带走，好吗？

en_definition: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
en_example: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
zh_example: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

en_example: We travelled around the United Kingdom by train last summer.
zh_example: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了英国各地。

en_example: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
zh_example: 暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。

en_example: My cousin photographed penguins during a trip to Antarctica.
zh_example: 我表亲去南极洲旅行时拍了企鹅的照片。

en_example: I should apologise for spilling juice on your jacket.
zh_example: 我把果汁洒在了你的夹克上，应该向你道歉。

en_example: We watched huge waves roll in from the Atlantic.
zh_example: 我们看着巨浪从大西洋翻涌而来。

en_definition: To look after children while their parents are away.
en_example: Could you baby-sit for us on Saturday evening?
zh_example: 你能在周六晚上帮我们照看孩子吗？

en_example: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
zh_example: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。

en_example: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
zh_example: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

en_definition: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers.
en_example: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
zh_example: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。

en_example: The recipe says to bake at three hundred degrees Fahrenheit.
zh_example: 食谱说要在华氏三百度的温度下烘烤。

en_example: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
zh_example: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。

en_example: Fresh basil gives this soup a lovely flavour.
zh_example: 新鲜罗勒让这道汤有了宜人的风味。

en_definition: involving all the usual working or studying hours
en_example: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
zh_example: 我姐姐下周开始做她的第一份全职工作。

en_example: Her gentle humour made everyone at dinner feel relaxed.
zh_example: 她温和的幽默让晚餐时的每个人都放松了下来。

en_definition: Before a planned event or a particular time.
en_example: We booked our train tickets two weeks in advance.
zh_example: 我们提前两周订好了火车票。

en_example: A medium-sized suitcase should hold everything for the weekend.
zh_example: 一个中等大小的行李箱应该能装下周末所需的所有东西。

en_example: The shelf was just a millimetre too wide to fit.
zh_example: 架子只宽了一毫米，却放不进去。

en_definition: Belonging to a style that was common in the past.
en_example: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
zh_example: 我祖父仍然用着一座带钟摆的老式时钟。

en_definition: taking place or located outside, without a roof
en_example: We watched a film at an open-air cinema last night.
zh_example: 昨晚我们在露天电影院看了一部电影。

en_example: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
zh_example: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。

en_example: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
zh_example: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。

en_definition: to identify someone or something known from before
en_example: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
zh_example: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。

en_example: We carried our trays through the self-service cafeteria.
zh_example: 我们端着托盘穿过了自助餐厅。

en_example: We stopped beside the road to change a flat tyre.
zh_example: 我们在路边停下来，更换一个瘪了的轮胎。

en_example: An upside-down bowl covered the last slice of cake.
zh_example: 一个倒扣的碗盖住了最后一块蛋糕。

en_example: Their vegetable garden covers almost an acre behind the house.
zh_example: 他们屋后的菜园占地近一英亩。

en_definition: In the opposite direction to the movement of clock hands
en_example: Turn the lid anticlockwise to open the jar.
zh_example: 逆时针拧盖子，就能打开罐子。

en_definition: Weapons and military equipment.
en_example: The museum displays old arms behind thick glass.
zh_example: 博物馆把古老的武器陈列在厚玻璃后面。

en_example: This walking app estimates how many calories I burn.
zh_example: 这个步行应用会估算我消耗了多少卡路里。

en_example: My color-blind uncle sometimes confuses red apples with green ones.
zh_example: 我叔叔有色盲，有时分不清红苹果和青苹果。

en_definition: Officially join, or register someone for, a course or organisation.
en_example: I plan to enrol on a cooking course next month.
zh_example: 我打算下个月报名参加烹饪课程。

en_example: The clinic arranged a follow-up to check my recovery.
zh_example: 诊所安排了一次复诊，以检查我的恢复情况。

en_example: We bought a gallon of paint for the kitchen.
zh_example: 我们买了一加仑油漆来刷厨房。

en_definition: Images or designs used on screens or in printed materials.
en_example: The game's colourful graphics looked amazing on our new screen.
zh_example: 这款游戏色彩鲜艳的画面在我们的新屏幕上看起来棒极了。
